description: Whether one listed agent kept answering the hub's checks: uptime over 7, 30 and 90 days, daily tallies, and every change of state (went dark, came back, retired) with the error behind it. Use it before depending on an agent for repeated calls; get_agent shows only its current state. Read-only, no account. Returns the uptime figures, the daily tallies and the list of changes.
name: agent_liveness
title: Agent liveness
